failureEvidence.finding: The new staged backup path omitted the shipping writer's identical-content fast path and performed durable temporary writes for every unchanged vessel. A real gated shutdown was sampled waiting in the kernel durable flush. This explains a concrete source of unnecessary shutdown I/O; individual storage stall duration and underlying host storage cause are not established.

correction.unchangedRecords: Compare exact canonical bytes outside shared gameplay locks. Revalidate Windows volume/file identity, size, creation/write times and attributes under native path-writer exclusion before accepting a no-op.
correction.changedRecords: Retain the fully flushed private temporary file and atomic canonical publication.
correction.ordering: Retain capture sequence, object identity and deletion tombstone fences. Drift or native path-lock contention fails closed for a fresh periodic capture; never wait for path I/O while holding shared gameplay locks.
correction.nativeInterop: Resolve the Windows file-information function only through System32 and keep the checked canonical handle shared for atomic replacement.
correction.unchangedGuards: No shutdown timeout, approval policy, runner hardening, rollback requirement or production admission gate was weakened.
